findings: `learner.overview.text` conflates later overlap with 號 and 号’s current standardized status: it says the current “mark, sign, symbol, or number” senses arise “through its later convergence” with 號. Revise to say these senses are recorded for 号/號 after the forms came into overlapping use, then separately state that 号 is now the standardized simplified form of 號. The evidence supports later interchange and present simplification but does not establish that this standardization caused those senses (X-91d3406316913f6f3143, X-7d6ccb0af8942f340ff3, X-e54349ea8c3e82423961, X-384d2e7cba885d9c1d3f).
